skill.summary: professionals and job seekers create photos or images into LinkedIn-ready video using this skill. Accepts JPG, PNG, HEIC, WebP up to 200MB, renders on cloud...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of LinkedIn Photo Video Maker skill.

- Instantly creates LinkedIn-ready videos from your photos or images (JPG, PNG, HEIC, WebP up to 200MB).
- Cloud GPU rendering, typically delivers a 1080p MP4 within 30–60 seconds.
- Simple workflow: upload images, describe your video, download the result.
- Supports text overlays, background music, and batch editing.
- Handles token management, session creation, and common API tasks automatically.
- Provides clear user guidance, error feedback, and helpful tips for best results.
